profile.headline: Software Engineer | Walmart Inc.
profile.summary:
Experienced Software engineer with over 10 years of experience developing, maintaining, and optimizing highly efficient and secure web applications using Java and Spring Boot. 
Proficient in working in an agile development methodology, primarily in the Life Sciences, Financial services, and Insurance industries. 
Hands-on experience utilizing different technologies like C#, Rest API, Python, NodeJs, ReactJS, Angular, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ElasticSearch, NoSQL and MSSQL.
Strong system design and architecture skills; leading several technical teams.
Obtaining master degree at Maharishi International University, Iowa, United States.
CJP Certified (2009), Bachelor's degree Mathematics and Computer Science (BSc),  University of Science, Vietnam.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Responsible for developing and maintaining web applications with React, Python, and Django.
Develop and migrate RESTful APIs and deliver high-quality source codes.
Involve in front-end development using React, Nextjs framework.
Apply CI/CD and containerization tools like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and deployed educational applications.
•	Built entire Library Management Request Form application using React and NodeJS, deployed on AWS which helped to cut down paperwork and reduce operational cost.
•	Created a Telegram chatbot, integrated with Canvas system for Online Course Discussion feature using Python and Flask framework.
•	Encrypted sensitive data using NodeJS and bcrypt hash algorithm, addressing the concerns from Compliance department and securely store data in the Cloud.
•	Wrote batch jobs using bash script to automatically execute the tasks based on schedules, resulting in a 25% increased productivity.
•	Developed an Admin tool using Python to extract student submissions and pre-assess by invoking AI services, helped Faculties save 2 days of effort per term.
